completion_evidence: PR #5 (-3) merged (a5257f7) and PR #4 (-2) closed as superseded with the reason recorded in the PR. main be9ab08 -> 295cc3c. -3 was RED on every CI run: 9 errors from stale fixture digests. Fixed in f48e3ba across all 6 places the digest was duplicated. Now 13/13 green on 3.11 and 3.13, and two clean builds produce equal logical digests (equivalent:true) -- the Prompt 7 acceptance bar actually passes rather than erroring before evaluation. DEVIATION, justified: PR #3 was MERGED (295cc3c), not closed as the plan assumed. It is not superseded -- all 4 files are new, it merges clean, and it ships tools/verify_audit_findings.py. Run against merged main it reports 8/8 findings NOT reproduced, 0 errors: executable proof that PR #5 closed every defect the first-principles audit recorded.
